tool: immutable EP8 harness + explicitly declared variant hooks
purpose: Bound exposed communication, payload movement, launch/materialization, and synchronization through controlled differences
capability_probe: each variant reports a machine-readable ID and changed_components list
the full variant is bitwise/configuration-equivalent to the frozen measured path
correctness or intentionally changed semantics are declared before timing
preconditions: hold workload tensors, route, rank mapping, tuned configs, warmup, repetitions, clocks, and GPU lease constant
change exactly the components declared in changed_components
retain per-rank/per-repetition latency instead of only a reduced mean
do not add deltas from variants whose changed_components overlap
validate that no-payload and loopback controls preserve synchronization/metadata behavior they claim to retain

outputs.information: variant IDs, changed components, invariants and non-additivity warnings
rank-max latency, noise and regression evidence
revision, commands, scope, repetitions and raw paths

helps_diagnose: whether measured deltas survive route and token regimes
not_measured: independent additive component times when variants overlap

provenance.notes: Variant hooks must be implemented and audited in the operator harness; the generic framework only validates the experiment contract.
